A [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]]/[[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] alliance launched an '''attack''' against [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], destroying a [[Jedi outpost/Legends|Jedi outpost]].

==Prelude==
[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mavra Zane]] was assigned a group of [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]]<ref name="Kinect" /> around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]<ref name="Attack" /> to train at the [[Jedi outpost (Kashyyyk)|Kashyyyk Jedi outpost]]. They arrived there aboard a [[Unidentified Consular-class cruiser (Mavra Zane)|''Consular''-class cruiser]].<ref name="Kinect" />

==The attack==
After Master Zan arrived at the [[Jedi outpost/Legends|Jedi outpost]] with the [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]], an attack by a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]/[[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] alliance started. The Padawans took control of [[BARC speeder/Legends|BARC speeders]] to assist the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]]. They fought against Trandoshan [[Trandoshan airspeeder|Jungle speeders]]. They reached the nearby [[City/Legends|city]] and eventually fought off the first wave. Master [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] departed to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to get reinforcements.<ref name="Kinect" />

The second wave arrived sooner than expected. Zane ordered the Wookiees to get to their [[Raddaugh Gnasp fluttercraft/Legends|Raddaugh Gnasp fluttercraft]], but they were destroyed. The younglings and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] took control of a [[Seraph-class urban landspeeder|Flash speeder]] and fought against the Separatist [[NR-N99 Persuader-class droid enforcer/Legends|NR-N99 Persuader-class droid enforcer]] and [[OG-9 homing spider droid/Legends|OG-9 homing spider droids]]. Eventually they destroyed an [[Ubrikkian floating fortress]]. The younglings and Chewbacca were forced to escape to to the ''[[Star Runner]]''.<ref name="Kinect" />

They broke through the orbital fleet led by ''[[Nihilist]]'', damaging several [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent-class star frigates'']] and [[HCT-2001 Dragonboat-class Reugeot 905 freighter/Legends|HCT-2001 ''Dragonboat''-class Reugeot 905 freighters]].<ref name="Kinect" />

==Aftermath==
They went to [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] and aided a [[Rebellion on Felucia|rebellion]] there.<ref name="Kinect" />

==Behind the scenes==
The attack appears during the Jedi Destiny portion of the [[2012]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Kinect Star Wars]]''.
